map.Morse跌倒评估量表，6个项目评估患者跌倒风险（0-125分），分值越高风险越: The Morse Fall Scale scores fall risk across 6 items (0-125); higher score means greater risk. Click options to auto-score.
map.📖 查看「跌倒风险 Morse 评分评估器 使用指南」: View "Morse Score Fall-Risk Assessor User Guide"
map.本工具按 Morse 护理评分量表逐项计分并分层，结果仅供参考，以护士床旁评估与: This tool scores and stratifies per the Morse nursing scale; for reference only, subject to the nurse's bedside assessment and signature.
map.患者跌倒风险低，维持常规护理: Patient low fall risk; maintain routine care
map.25-50分：低度风险 → 床头悬挂\"防跌倒\"标识，加强宣教: 25-50: low risk -> hang 'fall-prevention' sign, reinforce education
map.≥51分：高度风险 → 落实跌倒高危护理措施，专人陪护，使用床栏: >=51: high risk -> high-risk measures, dedicated escort, bed rails
map.入院 24h 内完成评估，≥45 分挂高危标识并床旁陪护。: Assess within 24 h of admission; >=45 gets a high-risk sign and bedside escort.
map.用药变更（镇静或降压）后复评，捕捉认知与步态维度变化。: Reassess after medication change (sedative or antihypertensive) to catch cognition and gait changes.
map.教学演示六项权重，帮助新护士理解病史与辅助器具贡献。: Demonstrate the six weights to help new nurses understand history and aid contributions.
map.输入六项（跌倒史 25、次要诊断 15、辅助 15、静脉 20、步态 0、认知: Input six items (fall history 25, secondary dx 15, aid 15, IV 20, gait 0, cognition 0) total 75, high risk, matching the scale.
map.不能，仅提速，维度判定需护士床旁确认。: No; it only speeds entry. Dimension judgment needs bedside confirmation.
map.按高危管理并加强巡视，结合临床。: Manage as high-risk with closer rounds, per clinical reality.
map.至少入院、转科、病情变化时评估，高危者每周复评。: At least on admission, transfer and condition change; weekly for high-risk.
